newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 9.50-9.75 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 9.50-9.75 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were steady on Thursday in a narrow 9.50-9.75 percent range as state institutions kept up their substantial transfers of funds to the central bank, dealers said.
Bankers and dealers attributed the tight market this week to substantial fund transfers by state ministries to the central bank that have coincided with normal month-end withdrawals.
But several brokers expected the short market to begin to ease at the start of weekly trade on Saturday after some banks complete month-end "window dressing."
